title: Quilted MC
description: It has some performance improvements, but it mostly focuses on adding some fun mods to play with your friends.
body:
### Why install? This is a version of minecraft that i mostly play in. It has some performance improvements, but it mostly focuses on adding some fun mods to play with your friends. Primarily created so you can start your 2 week minecraft faze. There are some youtuber mods you might recognise. (shoutout doctor4t) ## What does it have to offer? From preformance enhacing to mods that change everything: ### Performance There are your ussual stuff like sodium and lithium with a sprinkle of some culling mods. ### Gameplay There are some vanilla+ mods like "Dungeons and Taverns" and "More mobs", but also total game machanics overhaul. For example: - "Enchahcement" witch adds completlly new achevements and reworks how they work. - "Advanced Netherite" witch adds more netherite tipes. - and more... ### Terrain To make the world fell bigger "Tectonic". ### Quality of Life

Sound mods like "Sound Physics Remasterd" and "Presence Footsteps".

Dynamic lighting with the help of "LambDynamicLights".
